entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: The Skoti god of the sea on Kaldheim, born a Cosmos monster dolphin, who took human form and claimed divinity.

entities.name: Omenkeel
entities.description: Cosima's magical longboat that carries passengers through the Cosmos to any destination in the Ten Realms.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: Clan that mentions Cosima in nearly every prayer at sea.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God with whom Cosima had three children.

entities.name: Gods' Hall
entities.description: Hall in the Gods' Realm where Cosima lived with Alrund for twenty years.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker who was given Cosima's longboat.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Started the Doomskar and was sought by Kaya at Gnottvold.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Invasion the gods fought, started by Tibalt.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: Recipient of the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: Demon whom Cosima confronted, noting he previously had no wings.

events.summary: Cosima and Alrund have three children and live in the Gods' Hall for twenty years before she leaves for the sea.
events.quote: She and Alrund had three children

events.summary: Kaya is given use of Cosima's longboat to find Vorinclex but is steered to Gnottvold to find Tibalt.
events.quote: but was steered towards Gnottvold to find Tibalt instead.

events.summary: Cosima fights the invading hordes in the Doomskar and helps Kaya cross enemy armies to deliver the Sword of the Realms to Halvar.
events.quote: She helped Kaya to cross the ranks of enemy armies so that the planeswalker could deliver the Sword of the Realms to Halvar .

events.summary: Cosima confronts Varragoth, noting he had no wings before, and tells Kaya she was on her boat.
events.quote: the goddess noted that the demon previously had had no wings

relations.quote: She and Alrund had three children

relations.note: lent her longboat and helped her
relations.quote: The planeswalker Kaya was given the use of Cosima's longboat
She and Alrund had three children ( Toralf , Birgi , and Kolvori )
